.NET Compiler Platform ("Roslyn")
Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp, Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Common, Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Analyzers
https://github.com/dotnet/roslyn

This file exists because the packages themselves do not carry one. Their .nuspec declares the
licence by SPDX expression (<license type="expression">MIT</license>, licenseUrl
https://licenses.nuget.org/MIT) and the only text inside the archives is ThirdPartyNotices for
Roslyn's own dependencies. MIT requires the copyright notice to accompany redistribution, and
Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.dll and Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.dll are redistributed in the engine
payload's bin/Tools/, so the notice has to come from somewhere. The copyright line below is the one
the packages declare in their .nuspec <copyright> element; the body is the standard MIT text.
